heldCase.reason: the host's qualified runtime could not be observed read-only: qualified Heretic runtime receipt process is not live. Nothing was run and no Home was touched.

sourceBoundaryFinding.harness: ContinuityPressureAdapter.hostRuntime formed a fresh Session with allowAcquisition=false and allowRuntimeStart=false, then bound through session.observeCurrentQualifiedRuntimeEvidence().
sourceBoundaryFinding.product: DirectCompanionTurn.perform(session, ...) begins a human turn through session.currentQualifiedRuntimeEvidence(...), which may recover one lost exact Product-owned runtime, then uses observeCurrentQualifiedRuntimeEvidence() read-only inside the started turn.
sourceBoundaryFinding.consequence: A013 entered at the read-only post-turn-start boundary and therefore could not exercise the Product's new-turn runtime recovery boundary when the stored runtime process was gone.

causalStanding: A013 proves Foundation v0.6.15 source/tests at PR #487 passed, but produces no model response. The hold is attributable to the experiment harness's stricter runtime-admission boundary. It does not establish why the underlying runtime process disappeared and does not count for or against v0.6.15 semantics.
